results.text: Old Drug, New Science: Metformin and the Future of Pharmaceutics. Metformin, a 60-year-old biguanide and cornerstone of type 2 diabetes therapy, continues to challenge and inspire modern pharmaceutical science. Despite its chemical simplicity, metformin displays highly complex pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic behavior driven by transporter dependence, luminal activity, and formulation-sensitive exposure.
